mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, birth_date AS birthDate, phone, zip_code AS zipCode, addr, status, role, grade_id AS gradeId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_id AS oauthId from member where login_id = #{value}

SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, birth_date AS birthDate, phone, zip_code AS zipCode, addr, status, role, grade_id AS gradeId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, oauth_provider AS oauthProvider, oauth_id AS oauthId from member where oauth_id = #{outhId} AND oauth_provider = #{oauthProvider}

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.login_id AS loginId, m.name, m.phone, m.status, m.role, m.grade_id AS gradeId, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM member m WHERE 1=1
AND m.status = #{status}
AND ( m.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.member_id as memberId, m.login_id as loginId, m.name, m.birth_date as birthDate, m.phone, m.zip_code as zipCode, m.addr, m.status, m.role, m.created_at as createdAt, m.updated_at as updatedAt, m.last_login_at as lastLoginAt, m.oauth_provider as oauthProvider, m.oauth_id as oauthId, g.grade_id as gradeId, g.grade_name FROM member m LEFT JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.grade_id WHERE m.member_id = #{value}
